name: Check AI Export
author: Thorsten Glander

sections.description:
IMPORTANT: This plugin requires the official Plugin Check plugin to be installed and active. This plugin acts as an extension to export results from Plugin Check.

Check AI Export turns the results of the official WordPress Plugin Check into a workspace: run the check, understand every finding, fix it with your AI assistant and track your progress until the plugin is ready for WordPress.org.

Learn more about our tools at press-suite.com.

Features

  • Scan Workspace – Run Plugin Check directly in Settings → Check AI Export. Results are saved, so you can come back to them later
  • Better Result List – Group by file or by error code, see duplicates at a glance (“23× in 4 files”), filter errors (submission blockers) and warnings, search
  • Prompt per Finding – Copies one finding together with the surrounding source code, so your AI can give a precise fix
  • Coding Agent Prompt – Task list with file paths for Claude Code, Cursor and similar tools
  • Offline Fix Hints – Explanations with before/after examples for the most common Plugin Check codes, no AI or API key needed
  • Ignore False Positives – Mark findings as ignored with a reason; they are left out of counts, exports and prompts
  • Security Check – Finds typical vulnerabilities in the plugin code that Plugin Check does not look for: AJAX/admin-post handlers without nonce or capability check, REST routes without permission check, is_admin() as permission check, request data in code execution, unserialize() or include
  • Progress Tracking – Status light “Ready for WordPress.org?”, changes since the last scan and a chart of the last 10 scans
  • One-Click Export – Export all Plugin Check results with a single click
  • Copy to Clipboard – Directly copy and paste into your AI
  • Download as File – Save results as a .txt file
  • Token Optimization – Choose between compact and detailed formats
    • Compact: ~40-60 tokens per issue (saves ~60% tokens!)
    • Detailed: ~100-150 tokens per issue (comprehensive)
  • Clear Summary – Automatically counts errors, warnings, and info
  • Export History – Keep track of your last 20 exports in a dedicated History tab
  • Native WordPress UI – Seamlessly integrates into the Plugin Check interface

Token Savings

  • 10 errors: Detailed (~1,800 tokens) vs Compact (~600 tokens) = 67% savings
  • 20 errors: Detailed (~3,600 tokens) vs Compact (~1,300 tokens) = 64% savings
  • 50 errors: Detailed (~9,000 tokens) vs Compact (~3,000 tokens) = 67% savings

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • The official Plugin Check plugin (available on WordPress.org)

Usage

  1. Go to Settings → Check AI Export → Scan
  2. Choose a plugin and click “Run Plugin Check”
  3. Work through the findings: “How to fix”, “Show code”, “Copy prompt” or “Copy prompt for coding agent”
  4. Paste the prompt into ChatGPT, Claude, or any other AI tool and apply the fix
  5. Scan again and watch the status light turn green

Recommended Settings

For Cost-Conscious Users (API Usage):
* Export Format: Compact
* Include Summary: Yes
* Include Metadata: No
* Include AI Instructions: No
Result: ~600 tokens for 10 errors

For Comprehensive Analysis:
* Export Format: Detailed
* Include Summary: Yes
* Include Metadata: Yes
* Include AI Instructions: Yes
Result: ~1,500 tokens for 10 errors

Privacy

This plugin does not:
* Collect any user data
* Send data to external servers
* Track user behavior
* Use cookies

All operations are performed locally within your WordPress installation.
sections.installation:
1. Make sure the official Plugin Check plugin is installed and active.
  2. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/check-ai-export directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  4. Go to Settings → Check AI Export, choose a plugin in the Scan tab and click “Run Plugin Check”.
  5. Optional: configure the export format in the Export Settings tab. The export buttons are also available on the original Plugin Check page (Tools → Plugin Check).
sections.faq:
Do I need the Plugin Check plugin installed?

Yes, this plugin works as an extension to the official WordPress Plugin Check plugin.

What is the difference between Compact and Detailed format?

Compact format shows only essential information (file, line, code, message) in one line per error, saving ~60% tokens. Detailed format includes all available information (severity, column, descriptions, documentation links) for comprehensive analysis.

How reliable is the security check?

It looks for code patterns that are typical for vulnerabilities, without running your code. Most findings point to real problems, but some can be intended (for example a webhook that verifies a signature itself). Review each finding and mark false positives as ignored. The check is no replacement for a professional security audit.

Can the free version fix my code automatically?

No. The free version helps you understand the findings and prepares precise prompts for your AI assistant; you apply the fixes yourself. The PRO version fixes the most common findings automatically with fixed rules (no AI, no API costs) and the rest with AI if you want, with automatic backups.

Why are some findings not shown after I ignored them?

Ignored findings are hidden by default. Tick “Show ignored” in the Scan tab to see and restore them.

Does this plugin send data to external servers?

No, all operations are performed locally in your WordPress installation. No data is sent to external servers.

Can I customize the export format?

Yes, go to Settings → Check AI Export → Export Settings to choose between Compact and Detailed formats, and enable/disable optional sections like metadata, summary, and AI instructions.

Which format should I use?

Use Compact format if you’re experienced with WordPress standards and want to save AI tokens (especially when using paid APIs). Use Detailed format if you’re learning or need comprehensive explanations with documentation links.
